title: Skip static top-bar filenames during keyboard navigation
steps: View the open Meeting notes.txt document and its filename in the top bar, with Close as the starting keyboard position.
Press Shift+Tab twice to traverse backwards from Close through the top-bar controls.
Press Enter on the resulting focused element and inspect the resulting page.

video_guide.summary: Reverse Tab reaches My Account after the context-menu control; Enter opens the account menu.

chapters.note: Meeting notes.txt is open in Text Editor, and Close has a focus outline.
A Close tooltip is visible beneath the outlined toolbar control.

chapters.label: Press Shift+Tab to move backward from Close.

chapters.note: The three-dot control has a focus outline and a Show context menu tooltip.
My Account is outlined at the top right with its tooltip visible; Meeting notes.txt remains visible in the toolbar.
The account menu is open with Preferences and Log out visible beside the open document.

chapters.label: Use Tab to move into the account menu.

chapters.note: Preferences has a rectangular focus outline inside the account menu, while the document remains open.
